topic: A 6'8" basketball player in a headband looks up in disbelief while talking to a 7'9" player.

hook.first_words: The guy in the headband is 6'8"
hook.first_frame: A tall Florida basketball player standing on the court next to a player wearing a headband looking up at him.
hook.on_screen_text_0_3s: The guy in the headband is 6'8" and he's never had to look up to talk to someone

shots.shows: Continuous broadcast clip of a headband-wearing player looking way up at 7'9" Florida player Olivier Rioux on the court.

captions.colours: white text with black drop shadow

ending.last_frame: The tall Florida player glances over and responds while standing on the basketball court.

script: The guy in the headband is 6'8" and he's never had to look up to talk to someone in his life, so he couldn't believe it when he met this 7'9" player. You're a freshman? Yeah. You're a big boy! Where you from? Where you from? Uhh, Canada.
what_makes_it_work: Dramatic visual height contrast between two tall college basketball players.
Amusing dialogue captions detailing the shorter player's genuine surprise.
Instant hook in the first line framing the situation clearly.
